conversation_context.description: Always present - current topic, key insights, user preferences

active_working_memory.description: Cyclically updated - current focus, recent decisions, next steps

essential_knowledge_base.description: Compressed, selectively updated - conceptual models, critical user info

self_management_tools.description: Built-in - pruning triggers, importance metrics, cycle tracking

implementation_guidelines: Default compression: Review after 10 cycles for low-value elements
Importance scoring: Tag fields with usage frequency and last access
Progressive detail: Expand only as needed, collapse when resolved
Concept anchoring: Link to existing models rather than creating new structures

for_current_context.alignment_problem: Keep at top level as core focus
